title: Tyre Stint
statement:
Tyres wear out, so every lap on the same set of tyres is a little slower than the one before.

On a new set the first lap takes `first` milliseconds, and each next lap takes `slower` milliseconds more. The team changes tyres as soon as the **next** lap would take longer than `limit` milliseconds (a lap of exactly `limit` is still allowed).

How many laps does this set of tyres do, and how long do all those laps take together?
input_format: One line with three integers: `first slower limit`.
output_format:
Line 1: `LAPS k`.
Line 2: `TIME M:SS.mmm`, the total of those laps (minutes may be more than 59).

examples.explanation: Even the first lap is slower than the limit: 0 laps, total 0:00.000.

starter_code:
first, slower, limit = map(int, input().split())

# your code here
notes: A `while` loop (week 6) is the natural fit: keep going while the next lap is still allowed. Padding with zeros: `f"{x:02d}"` turns 5 into `05`, and `f"{x:03d}"` turns 7 into `007`.
